claim: 2023–2025 audited financial history is the historical model base.
adopted_wording: Historical revenue, profit, cash-flow and balance-sheet data are audited issuer disclosure.
valuation_consequence: Historical base only; do not direct-annualize.

claim: 2026Q1 revenue CNY2.830bn, attributable NP CNY0.339bn and CFO -CNY0.431bn.
adopted_wording: 2026Q1 is the latest full reported quarter.
valuation_consequence: Starting point; cannot annualize.

claim: 2026H1 preliminary attributable NP is CNY1.10–1.30bn.
adopted_wording: H1 preliminary profit is a constraint, not a full financial statement.
valuation_consequence: Constrain H1; all missing line items stay assumptions.

claim: 2026Q2 preliminary attributable NP is CNY0.761–0.961bn.
adopted_wording: The company directly prints the Q2 attributable-NP range.
valuation_consequence: No Q2 revenue/volume/margin split may be inferred as fact.

claim: 2025 lithium sales were 69,493.81 tonnes with nearly 130kt design capacity.
adopted_wording: Historical volume and design capacity establish an operating base, not 2026 utilization.
valuation_consequence: No full-capacity or unit-margin credit.

claim: 2025 lithium revenue/cost were CNY4.824bn/CNY4.234bn and gross margin was 12.22%.
adopted_wording: 2025 is a blended historical product base.
valuation_consequence: Not a 2026 ASP or cost input without explicit assumption label.

claim: Resource rights prove a 2026 self-supply cost advantage.
adopted_wording: Rights and priority supply are confirmed, but self-supply ratio, delivered tonnes and cash cost are not disclosed.
valuation_consequence: No premium until a company-specific economics bridge exists.

claim: 2025 civil-explosives revenue and product/service gross margins establish a base business.
adopted_wording: Historic civil-explosives base is disclosed; 2026Q2/H1 contribution is not.
valuation_consequence: No current-period earnings uplift without evidence.

claim: Cash conversion is a material risk.
adopted_wording: 2025 and Q1 CFO were negative while profits were positive.
valuation_consequence: Base/bear model must contain working-capital or cash-conversion sensitivity.

claim: 2026-07-23 close was CNY17.75 and equity value CNY20.458bn.
adopted_wording: L2 price times L1 total share count matches the L2 market cap.
valuation_consequence: Valuation-date denominator.

claim: The H1 preview caused the 7 July limit-up.
adopted_wording: Disclosure date and daily return are confirmed; precise release time and causality are not.
valuation_consequence: No event-causality conclusion.

claim: Disclosure-window relative return against lithium observation peers.
adopted_wording: Use raw same-window return only; no alpha or causal conclusion.
valuation_consequence: Market context only.

claim: Lithium peer Q1 recovery supports an industry beta.
adopted_wording: Peer Q1 disclosure supports sector price beta, not direct profit transfer.
valuation_consequence: No peer unit-profit/margin transfer.

claim: Peer 2026E P/E range is 11.71–13.51x.
adopted_wording: Secondary aggregated P/E is external calibration only.
valuation_consequence: Maximum 20% calibrated-house-P/E check; no standalone target price.

claim: The three broker 2026E EPS forecasts span CNY2.01–2.63.
adopted_wording: Dated external forecast range, not vendor consensus or house EPS.
valuation_consequence: Maximum 20% combined forecast-reconciliation weight.

claim: Dongwu CNY42 is a Street consensus target.
adopted_wording: CNY42 is one analyst's explicit 16x 2026E P/E target.
valuation_consequence: Maximum 15% external target-price sanity check; no target consensus.

claim: Kaiyuan quantitatively raised 2026/27 estimates.
adopted_wording: Current report prints 2026E NP 1.699→2.569bn and 2027E 1.820→3.022bn.
valuation_consequence: Revision evidence only; no issuer-guidance substitution.

claim: Lithium spot proves Yahua ASP or margin.
adopted_wording: Commodity price is L3 scenario context.
valuation_consequence: No direct revenue/cost or target-price input.

claim: NEV sales prove Yahua customer orders.
adopted_wording: Terminal demand is directional context only.
valuation_consequence: No order/volume credit.

claim: Civil-explosives policy proves company earnings growth.
adopted_wording: Policy is regulatory context, not company profit evidence.
valuation_consequence: No earnings or multiple premium.

claim: Lithium sulfide is a booked second growth curve.
adopted_wording: No capacity, customer, order or revenue disclosure is archived.
valuation_consequence: Exclude from base earnings and target price.

claim: China Shipbuilding parameters can support Yahua forecast or valuation.
adopted_wording: Method-only reference.
valuation_consequence: No fact, forecast, multiple, target or action transfer.
